scope: Retain existing mathematical source commands needed by the final theorem and by elaboration of its proof; restore accidentally deleted commands verbatim from the backup.
method: Load all compiled modules at OLeanLevel.private; traverse full types, theorem/opaque/definition bodies, structure projections, inductive constructors and recursor rules.
Map kernel constants to complete parsed source commands; supplement the closure with explicit source references, scope commands and the three custom tactic providers.
Retain whole declarations, including structures and their generated projections/instances; do not weaken interfaces or assumptions.
Classify Lean reserved-name equation/congruence lemmas as regenerated on demand rather than treating the first generating module as a source proof dependency.
Delete unreachable files and commands. Validate the original proof by rebuilding; restore only original source when elaboration finds an erased dependency.
